Dear Akash,

You asked how I manage at the children's hospital without falling apart. Honestly, I didn't at first. In my first months as a play therapist, I felt every child's fear as if it were mine and went home shaking. Now I do something different. Before I walk into a room, I stop at the door and take three slow breaths. I remind myself: this is their fear, I can hold their hand without drowning in it. Warmly,
Devika
